editorial: Even before sunrise, a town's stillness shivers as a murder appears impossible, twisting a sleepy parish into a playground for dark curiosity. Unlike conventional whodunits, a youthful priest and a silver-tongued detective collide, interrogating both dogma and deception in equal measure. Benoit Blanc's trademarkly spattered wit, coupled with real-world ambiguity, turns every dialogue into a cryptic note. Your eyebrows will rise as the script lays out the town's secrets like a scavenger hunt with no load-bearing steps. If you crave a mystery that feels more like an intellectual chase than a perfume of clichés, this film will keep you hooked although its pacing quavers midway through its more elaborate scenes.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
similarMovies: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
